accent: Global accent. Accents are built into the presets and can be programmed via the 'Accent' position of the Instrument Selector. The ACCENT (Accent Volume) knob sets the amount (turn right for more). Not per voice.
global_features: 34 preset patterns: 17 rhythm buttons x RHYTHM A/B switch, 20 rhythm names. From the manual's notation pages, FOX TROT/TANGO, MAMBO/CHA CHA and BEGUINE/RHUMBA appear to share a button as A/B (medium confidence, low-resolution scan).
Pressing two rhythm buttons together combines both patterns; pressing three selects two by priority.
VARIATION selector: FILL IN 1-7, BREAK (one bar of rhythm, then one bar of rest), RHYTHM (A-B), ROLLING-HB, ROLLING-SD. MEASURE selector 2/4/8/12/16. AUTO/MANUAL switch plus MANUAL button.
FADE IN and FADE OUT (long and short).
BALANCE slider: emphasises the high percussion (cymbal, hi-hat, maracas) or the low (bass drum).
CANCEL VOICE buttons: CYMBAL + HIGH HAT, BASS DRUM, SNARE DRUM, COW BELL + CLAVES.

Programmer: 4 user rhythms (I-IV), each 2 bars = 96 counts (48 per bar), up to 4 voices (tracks 1-4) per rhythm. Real-time write with the TS-1 switch or a DP-1/DP-2 pedal. The optional WS-1 step writer splits the pattern into 8, 12, 24 or 48 steps.
No flam, no shuffle control, no per-voice tuning or decay.
TRIG OUT (8 beat / 16 beat / COMBI = bass drum + high bongo), EXT CLOCK in at 48 pulses per bar (+5 to +15 V), VARIATION and START/STOP pedal jacks, mono output (high and low impedance jacks).

accent: Global accent row (AC) programmed per step: 'The Accent can give emphasis to any other voices programmed on the same step.' The ACCENT knob sets the amount. TRIGGER OUT can also be set to fire on accents (ACC).
global_features: 24 preset rhythms: 3 banks (BANK SELECTOR I-III) x 8 PRESET RHYTHM buttons.
Two presets can be combined by pressing two buttons. A 3-beat or shuffle rhythm combined with a 4-beat one re-arranges the 4-beat pattern.

ARRANGER (8 buttons, any combination): CY-4" (4-beat cymbal), CY-8" (8-beat cymbal), HH-4", HH-16", OPEN HH (8-beat after-beat open hat), CONGA (hi, mid and lo conga), HAND CLAP (after-beat), SHUFFLE.
SHUFFLE converts rhythms to a shuffle beat (not WALTZ, SWING 1/2, SLOW ROCK or 12-step programs).
CRASH button; REGISTER alternates two patterns.
INTRO/FILL-IN: presets 1-8 (8 = BREAK), programs 9-12; auto fill every 16/12/8/4/2 bars, or MANUAL.
Programming: 8 basic programs of 2 bars x 16 steps (12 steps per bar with shuffle). Intro/fill programs are 1 bar. Step write uses note and rest buttons.
6 VOICE LEVEL knobs: BASS DRUM; TOM TOM/RIM SHOT/SNARE DRUM; CONGA; CLAVES/COWBELL; CYMBAL/HI HAT; HAND CLAP. No per-voice tuning or decay.
Choke groups shown are voices that share a level knob (manual) and per polynominal a sound channel. Whether they actually cut each other off is unverified; HH/OHH choking is a safe Drum Rack choice.
Mono output. TRIGGER OUT +5 V 10 ms, selectable 8"/16"/ACC. DIN SYNC IN/OUT (CSQ-600, MC-4, JP-8). Remote jacks: START/STOP, RESTART, INTRO/FILL-IN, REGISTER. LED tempo display.
